basics.label: DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: DevOps engineer focused on reducing toil for development and operations engineers. I implement industry best practices that align with business goals. I communicate technical implementations to non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into architectural decisions.

work.name: Cellusys
highlights: Migrated legacy telecom systems to cloud-native solutions in multi-region Kubernetes clusters.
Designed and implemented a staging environment to test rollouts, making production deployments safer.
Built a benchmarking environment to continuously test system performance.
Architected CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Argo CD) that shortened the time from commit to production.
Introduced a development environment to unify dev workflows and reduce the time it takes to onboard new engineers.
Integrated modern observability solutions (ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana, kube-state-metrics) to improve visibility into the system.
Evaluated production Kubernetes cluster robustness by simulating failure scenarios to verify compliance with customer SLAs.
Adopted agentgateway to centralize interaction between AI agents and MCP servers.
